title: Uruguayan Empanadas
description: A traditional Uruguayan dish filled with comte cheese and served as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: In a bowl, mix the shredded comte cheese and a pinch of salt.
Place an empanada disc on a flat surface and brush the edges with the beaten egg.
Place 1 tablespoon of the comte cheese mixture in the center of the empanada disc.
Fold the empanada in half and press the edges to seal.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg and sprinkle with water.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
